records.title: Bitquery updated Binance incident investigation — nine chains and current XRP receiver
records.note: The refreshed investigation says 17 Binance hot wallets drained across nine chains, approximately $2.7B frozen/rescued, and approximately $3.2B still with the attacker at its 06:43 UTC chain cutoff. It explicitly lists the XRPL receiver at approximately 233.5M XRP and says it has never sent a transaction. Bitquery says each drained wallet carries a Binance PoR label in its address data. It also clarifies that XRP and Solana drains share no address with the other incident chains; the XRP link is timing, unusual transaction construction and Binance's own incident total. This is a provider attribution and same-chain trace, not a direct official Binance PoR address-set crosswalk.

records.title: Reuters — TRM attributes Binance incident to TraderTraitor across ten blockchains
records.note: Reuters reports TRM Labs attributes the approximately $6.3B incident to North Korea's TraderTraitor with high confidence, based on on-chain and off-chain intelligence, and describes activity across ten blockchains. Bitquery's refreshed investigation describes nine chains. The chain-count discrepancy is preserved as provider-scope/methodology uncertainty; do not collapse to one count. Attribution is an analytics assessment, not a finding from the XRP transaction alone.
